## What this changes

One or two sentences describing the behavior that is different after this merges.

## Why

The problem this solves. If you tried an obvious approach first and found it did not
work, explain why — that context is often the most useful part of a pull request.

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` is green
- [ ] New behavior has a test, or documented why it does not need one
- [ ] No model, vendor, or version name was added to an agent's identity
- [ ] No model default was added that applies without the user choosing it
- [ ] Tool results and prompts did not grow without a reason proportionate to the tokens
